stem.text: An alkene reacts with hot, concentrated, acidified potassium manganate(VII) to produce a single organic product as shown.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: alkene, then arrow labelled hot, concentrated, acidified KMnO4(aq), giving a skeletal formula of the product with a ketone C=O group at one end, a methyl branch, and a terminal COOH group.

stem.text: What is the structure of the alkene?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexene ring with a methyl group on one alkene carbon and a methyl group on the ring.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexene ring with two methyl groups.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclopentene ring with two methyl groups.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclopentene ring with one methyl group on an alkene carbon and one methyl group on the ring.
